div.head: Shiji I: Basic Annals
div.p: Basic Annals of the First Emperor of Qin: When he was thirteen, King Zhuangxiang died, and Zheng took his place as King of Qin. At this time Qin's territory had already annexed Ba, Shu and Hanzhong, and, passing beyond Wan, held Ying, where Nan Commandery had been set up; in the north it had taken in Shang Commandery and the lands east of it, and held the Commanderies of Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang; in the east it reached Xingyang, having wiped out the two Zhou and set up Sanchuan Commandery. Lü Buwei was Chancellor, enfeoffed with a hundred thousand households and styled Marquis Wenxin. He drew retainers and travelling gentlemen to him, meaning by them to annex all under Heaven. Li Si was a household retainer. Meng Ao, Wang Yi, Lord Biao and others were Generals. The king was young and newly on the throne, and left the affairs of state to the great ministers.
Jinyang revolted; in the first year the General Meng Ao attacked and settled it.
